entries.title: The Run
body: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.
Explore rooms, survive fights and claim rewards on the way to each dragon.

entries.title: Map and Rooms
body: Choose your route through the section's rooms.
Revealed exits show where you can travel next, and cleared rooms stay open as routes.

entries.title: Character
body: Your gear, magic, items and skills.
Gear, magic and items form your deck. Change them outside combat, including before a battle and at an Ember Hearth.

entries.title: Rewards
body: After combat, take 1 of 3 cards, or skip to heal 3.
Gained magic cards go straight into your deck; Purge removes one.

entries.title: Relics
body: Passive effects that last the whole run.
Find them in Relic rooms and win them from dragons and Guardians. Hover relic badges in the top HUD for their current text.

entries.title: Combat Board
body: The 9×9 grid where combat happens.

Card previews show legal targets, affected tiles and the results before you commit. Enemies show their next attack and the order they act in; red tiles will be struck before your next turn. Press I for every enemy's full plan. Undo move (Z) takes back free Movement until you play a card.

entries.title: Turn Clock
body: The unit with the lowest Time acts next; you win ties.
The turn order shows the coming turns.

entries.title: Card Play
body: Each card you play spends one; they refill each turn, and kills give one more.
The Card Plays counter shows how many you have left this turn.

entries.title: Health and Defenses
body: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.

entries.title: Defiance
body: Each charge turns a lethal hit into 25% Health.
You get 1 charge per 4 permanent levels, refilled at the start of each run.

entries.title: Targeting
body: Targets must be visible and in Range; ranged attacks need line of sight.
Legal targets light up while you aim.

entries.title: Fatigue
body: Drawing from an empty pile reshuffles your discard and costs Health.
A Draw card's preview and the Pass forecast show the Health it will cost.

entries.title: Traps
body: Trigger when entered or attacked, hitting the unit on them and spreading their element around them.

entries.title: Outcrops
body: Attackable terrain that blocks movement.
Attack one to break it and open a route.

entries.title: Lightning Strikes
body: Strikes the marked tiles, then leaves them Electrified.

entries.title: Summon
body: Calls the shown enemy into the fight.
Its intent shows what will arrive, or Summon blocked when nothing can.

entries.title: The Umbra
body: Darkness that hides enemies and their intents.
Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra push it back.

entries.title: Melee
body: Damage an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.

entries.title: Ranged
body: Damage a target in Range and line of sight.

entries.title: Move
body: Walk up to that many tiles.
Pick your own tile to stay.

entries.title: Blink
body: Teleport up to that many tiles to a visible open tile.
Pick your own tile to stay.

entries.title: Block
body: Absorbs damage until its holder's next turn.

entries.title: Stoneskin
body: Absorbs damage after Block; lasts until used up.

entries.title: Heal
body: Restore that much Health.

entries.title: Draw
body: Draw that many cards.
A Draw card's chip shows how many cards will really come.

entries.title: Card Play
body: Each card you play spends one; they refill each turn, and kills give one more.

entries.title: Follow-up
body: Gain the bonus if you already played a card this turn.
The card's numbers update in your hand while the bonus is active.

entries.title: Empower
body: Pay the extra cost as you play this card to gain its bonus.
Charge the card with the Empower seal on its top-right corner (or press E; the right stick on a controller). A charged card glows and stays charged until you play it or your turn ends.

entries.title: Stagger
body: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time.
Hover a Stagger target to preview its new place in the turn order.

entries.title: Illusion
body: A decoy with that much Health; enemies attack it if it's as close as you.

entries.title: Immobilize
body: Can't Move, Blink or Swap during its next turn.

entries.title: Exhaust
body: Leaves your deck for the rest of combat.

entries.title: Retaliate
body: Until its next turn, whoever hits this unit up close takes that much damage.

entries.title: Quicken
body: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time.
The Time badge shows the discount.

entries.title: Next Attack
body: Your next attack this turn gains the bonus.

entries.title: Rite
body: Its effect lasts the rest of combat and the card Exhausts.

entries.title: Health Cost
body: Lose that much Health.

entries.title: Pierce
body: Ignores Block and Stoneskin.

entries.title: Bleed
body: Takes that much damage before each move or attack.

entries.title: Freeze
body: Skips its next turn and takes triple damage until then.

entries.title: Shock
body: On its next turn, it can only Move or Blink.

entries.title: Expose
body: Its next damaging hit takes that much more damage.

entries.title: Sunder
body: Strips that much Block, then Stoneskin, before damage.

entries.title: Chain
body: Jumps to new targets within that many tiles of each hit.

entries.title: Push
body: Move the target that many tiles straight away; if blocked, Collision.
When the target is off to a diagonal, Rotate picks which side it goes before you commit.

entries.title: Pull
body: Move the target that many tiles straight closer; if blocked, Collision.
When the target is off to a diagonal, Rotate picks which side it comes before you commit.

entries.title: Collision
body: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per tile left, to both units.

entries.title: Consume
body: Gone for the rest of the run once used.

entries.title: Radiance
body: Cards that push back the Umbra.

entries.title: Light
body: Lights tiles within its radius through the Umbra.

entries.title: Vision
body: See that many tiles farther for the shown turns.

entries.title: Truesight
body: Every enemy counts as visible for the shown turns.

entries.title: Dispel Umbra
body: Lower the Umbra by that many stages this combat.

entries.title: Tunnel Crawler
body: Fast close-range predator that closes distance and opens Bleed wounds.
Its intents favor short movement paths followed by melee Bleed attacks.

entries.title: Dust Acolyte
body: Ranged caster with dust bolt attacks, self-defense actions, and Health-draining effects.
Its intents alternate between line-of-sight damage and preservation.

entries.title: Bone Harrier
body: Mobile ranged skirmisher with pierce and Bleed attacks.
Its intents often combine repositioning with a ranged strike.

entries.title: Stone Warden
body: Durable front-line guard with heavy melee attacks, Block gains, and close area strikes.
It can absorb damage through defenses before its Health is exposed.

entries.title: Cinder Ooze
body: Fire ooze whose attacks leave Fire tiles. Slag Shell Expends nearby Fire for extra Block; killing the ooze can split it into droplets.

entries.title: Cinder Droplet
body: Small Fire fragment spawned by a Cinder Ooze. Its attacks leave Fire tiles.

entries.title: Shale Bloomer
body: Earth controller whose attacks cover the struck tiles in Rubble and Expose targets. Shale Shell Expends nearby Rubble for additional Stoneskin.

entries.title: Chainbound Gaoler
body: Air-locked jailer that pulls, pushes, and restricts movement.
Its intents use forced movement and Immobilize to alter reachable tiles.

entries.title: Grave Surgeon
body: Support enemy that heals and guards allies. Its guard clears elemental ground beneath its target.

entries.title: Frostglass Lancer
body: Ice striker that creates Ice tiles and follows up with Freeze. Refract Guard clears Ice beneath the Lancer.

entries.title: Zekarion, the Raging Tempest
body: Storm dragon supported by Lightning Wisps. Skybreak and Storm Lash leave Electrified ground.
When Zekarion uses Overload, lightning strikes every Electrified tile for 6. At half Health, lightning strikes every Electrified tile for 7. Stay off charged ground, or lure its Wisps onto it.

entries.title: Lightning Wisp
body: Lightning minion that creates Electrified tiles. Capacitor Arc inflicts Shock when conducted through Electrified.

entries.title: Worldspines
body: Tharokh marks a line of tiles between you and it, and they rise as Outcrops after every second turn of yours.
Break an Outcrop to open a route.

entries.title: Meteorfall and Crownfire
body: Marks tiles that take damage and turn to Fire when it lands.
Replace the Fire to deny Crownfire's blast, or lure the dragon into it.

entries.title: Hollow Gale
body: Strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx and Pushes struck actors 1 tile.
Escape the outer edge of Eye of the Storm, or step into the eye and face a weaker bite.

entries.title: Gusts and Vortices
body: An area force pushes or pulls every enemy within its radius of a center: you, or a tile you choose.

entries.title: Swap
body: Trade places with a visible enemy or your illusion.

entries.title: Stances
body: A stance is a rule a card gives you for a while; active stances appear as badges on your character.

entries.title: Cleanse
body: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.

entries.title: Petrify
body: Skips its next turn and gains 5 Block.

entries.title: Crystal Mantle
body: Each layer cancels one direct hit.
Cheap hits can clear layers before a heavy strike.

entries.title: Last Eclipse
body: Hits anyone outside Light, then plunges the room into Eclipse.
Stand in Light, or walk or Blink onto an unlit brazier to relight it.

entries.title: Veilbound Acolyte
body: Shadow minion that fights beside Noctyrax and disappears when Umbra hides its tile.
Radiance and truesight reveal its position before its ranged needles and closing strikes resolve.

entries.title: Tharokh, the Worldspine
body: Earth dragon that walls you in, with Burrow Grubs at its side.

After every second turn of yours, Tharokh's marked tiles rise as Outcrops. A marked tile stays flat if the unit on it can't be pushed off or has nowhere to land. At half Health they rise after each of your turns. Break through before the wall closes.

entries.title: Vyraketh, the Cinder Crown
body: Fire dragon that lays marked Fire, with Cinder Droplets that leave more of it.

When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions. At half Health its Fire spreads after every second Vyraketh turn. Crownfire detonates its own marked Fire, and its bite renews the marks.

entries.title: Vaeloryx, the Hollow Gale
body: Air dragon that strikes from the sky and dives at you, with Gust Shrikes riding its wind.
After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushes everyone 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise. At half Health it Pushes 2 tiles. Its retreating storm combines a wide ring with a weaker close bite.

entries.title: Iskaldra, the Rime Tyrant
body: Ice dragon protected by visible Crystal Mantle layers, with Rime Spitters laying Ice around it.

When Iskaldra uses Rime Talon, Frostbite hits everyone on Ice for 3 and Freezes them. At half Health, Frostbite hits after every second Iskaldra turn instead. Break Mantle layers to shrink Shatterstorm's reach.

entries.title: Noctyrax, the Last Eclipse
body: Shadow dragon and final boss of the twenty-fourth depth, with Veilbound Acolytes hiding in its darkness.
When Noctyrax uses Void Claw, hidden Veilbound Acolytes Blink 3 tiles toward you. Night Coil snuffs a brazier; enter its tile to relight it. Light blocks Eclipse's darkness.

entries.title: Ground
body: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles.

entries.title: Fire
body: Entering deals 2 damage; starting a turn here deals 3.

entries.title: Ice
body: Units on it are Chilled.

entries.title: Electrified
body: Lightning hits spread across connected Electrified tiles.

entries.title: Rubble
body: Costs 2 Movement to leave.

entries.title: Chilled
body: Takes 2 more damage from attacks; an Ice attack Freezes it.

entries.title: Detonate
body: Blow up the chosen ground, hitting everyone on and next to it, you included.

entries.title: Expend
body: Remove the shown ground to power this effect.

entries.title: Relocate Ground
body: Move a ground tile to another open tile.

entries.title: Reflect
body: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.

entries.title: Flying
body: Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage.

entries.title: Marked
body: These tiles take the hit on this enemy's next turn.

entries.title: Charge
body: At 3 Charge it unleashes Arc Burst; Shock removes 1.

entries.title: Gust
body: On its beat, the wind pushes every unit downwind.

entries.title: Upheaval
body: On its beat, the marked tiles rise as Outcrops, throwing off whoever stands there.
Break an Outcrop to escape a ring of them.

entries.title: Bursts
body: When it dies, it hits every unit next to it and leaves Fire.

entries.title: Range
body: Maximum distance in tiles.
Count tiles without diagonals.

entries.title: Time
body: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.

entries.title: Eclipse
body: The darkest Umbra: you see only 1 tile around you.
Light still reveals tiles, and Dispel Umbra lowers it.

entries.title: Skate
body: This turn, Ice costs no Movement and doesn't Chill you.

entries.title: Fireproof
body: This turn, Fire ground doesn't hurt you.

entries.title: Convert Ground
body: Turn the chosen ground into another kind, hitting enemies on it.

entries.title: Discharge
body: Remove a connected Electrified network, hitting enemies on and next to it.

entries.title: Swap Illusion
body: Swap places with one of your illusions.

entries.title: Shatter Illusion
body: Destroy one of your illusions, hitting enemies next to it.

entries.title: Health
body: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.
Your Health carries over between rooms.

entries.title: Terrain Burst
body: Hits units around its terrain pieces.

entries.title: Crownfire
body: Detonates the Fire on its last Cinder Marks, hitting everyone caught.

entries.title: Guard Ally
body: Gives Block to the shown allies.

entries.title: Heal Ally
body: Heals the shown ally.

entries.title: Embers
body: Spent on wares and levels; dropped when you die.
Earn them from kills and victories. Recover dropped Embers on your next run.

entries.title: Fire
body: Fire cards place Fire ground and Detonate it.

entries.title: Ice
body: Ice cards place Ice and Freeze Chilled targets.

entries.title: Lightning
body: Lightning cards place Electrified ground and spread through it.

entries.title: Air
body: Air cards push, pull and move units.

entries.title: Earth
body: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.

entries.title: Skill Point
body: Earned by leveling; spend them on skills.
Spend them in the Character menu.

entries.title: Moltshards
body: Won from your first dragon; trade for Embers or reset your skills.

entries.title: Wait
body: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.

entries.title: Turns
body: How many of your turns this effect lasts.
∞ means it lasts all combat.

entries.title: Movement
body: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.

entries.title: Item
body: A one-use card from your item slots.
Equip items in your 2 item slots; each one joins your deck.

entries.title: Ground Techniques
body: Ground techniques turn the ground under enemies into hits.

entries.title: Sweeping Strike
body: Hits every visible enemy that meets the shown condition.
